title: OPRD: On-Policy Reminder Distillation for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.21496v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reliable repository-level coding requires agents not only to generate correct code but also to preserve constraints and respond to tool feedback across long interactions. However, our diagnostic analysis shows that agents often fail to act on relevant information already available in context, while final Pass/Fail outcomes provide only sparse process supervision. We introduce On-Policy Reminder Distillation (OPRD), which combines Multi-Scope Reminder supervision with outcome-based routing on reminder-free student rollouts. Successful rollouts provide autoregressive self-imitation targets, whereas failed rollouts receive Reminder-conditioned reverse-KL supervision from a teacher that re-evaluates the same student-generated prefixes. A Global Reminder converts final-test diagnostics into trajectory-level guidance, while Turn-local Reminders apply only to the next decision following the relevant environment observation. translated_title: OPRD：面向长时程编码智能体的在线策略提醒蒸馏
translated_abstract: 可靠的仓库级代码编写不仅要求智能体生成正确的代码，还要求智能体在长交互过程中保持约束条件并对工具反馈作出响应。然而，我们的诊断分析表明，智能体常常未能对上下文中已有的相关信息采取行动，而最终的通过/失败结果只能提供稀疏的过程监督。我们提出了在线策略提醒蒸馏（OPRD），该方法将多范围提醒监督与基于结果的路由机制相结合，应用于无提醒的学生策略回放。成功的回放可提供自回归的自我模仿目标，而失败的回放则从教师那里获得以提醒为条件的反向KL散度监督，该教师会重新评估相同的学生生成前缀。全局提醒将最终测试诊断转化为轨迹层面的指导，而局部提醒仅应用于相关环境观察之后的下一个决策。教师与学生
tldr: OPRD通过多范围提醒监督与基于结果的路由机制，将教师对失败轨迹的再评估能力以反向KL蒸馏方式传递给学生智能体，从而解决长时程编码智能体无法利用上下文信息和过程监督稀疏的问题。
en_tdlr: OPRD distills teacher diagnostic supervision into student coding agents via multi-scope reminder supervision with outcome-based routing, addressing the failure to act on in-context information and the sparsity of Pass/Fail-only process supervision in long-horizon coding tasks.
